description: Defines a CancelablePromise class with cancellation capabilities and a CancelError class for handling cancellation errors.

classes.name: CancelError
classes.description: Custom error class for cancellation errors, extending the built-in Error class.

classes.name: CancelablePromise
classes.description: A Promise implementation that supports cancellation via the cancel() method and tracks resolution, rejection, and cancellation states.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the promise, executes registered cancel handlers, and rejects the promise with a CancelError.
